simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֶכֶד (H5220) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נֶכֶד (neked) means offspring First listed occurrence: Gen 21 23.

definitions.full: H5220. neked נֶ֫כֶד noun [masculine] progeny, posterity , always with נִין in standing phrase (Ecclus 41:5; 47:22c; both with נין ); — absolute נ וְלֹא נִין ׳לֹא בְּעַמּוֺ Job 18:19 , compare וְנ וְנִין ׳וּשְׁאָר שֵׁם Isa 14:22 ; suffix וּלְנֶכְדִּי וּלְנִינִי לִי Gen 21:23 to me and to my offspring and to my posterity .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to propagate;
